verses.text: I am devoted to you and to those whom for the honour of God ye sent to Smyrna;
Whence also I write unto you with thanks giving to the Lord, having love for Metrodorus as I have for you also.
Remember me, even as I would that Jesus Christ may also remember you.
Pray for the church which is in Syria, whence I am led a prisoner to Rome—I who am the very last of the faithful there;
